title: Lost Mary Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Lost Mary's Pineapple Ice Nic Salt is a perfect tropical blend. It features the sweet, tangy, and juicy taste of exotic Pineapple on the inhale, followed by a sharp, crisp, and refreshing blast of ice on the exhale. Lost Mary Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same intense and popular flavours the brand is famous for. This 10ml e-liquid collection is perfect for vapers seeking a reliable, flavour-packed experience in a refillable format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour and carries flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher strengths, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Lost Mary Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. Perfect for your refillable vape UK or starter vape kit , this e-liquid keeps vaping simple and satisfying. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant, featuring a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety.
